chunks: The command for ramy al-jamarat was only given because Iblis, the accursed, used to appear to Ibrahim عليه السلام at the place of the jamarat, and Ibrahim عليه السلام would stone him; thus the sunnah came to be established by that.
And it has been narrated: "The first one to throw the pebbles at the jamarat was Adam عليه السلام, then Ibrahim عليه السلام."

key_terms.آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Prophet Adam, peace be upon him
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Prophet Ibrahim, peace be upon him
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition or normative practice
key_terms.رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ: the ritual casting of pebbles at the jamarat during hajj

ai.seo_question: Why was ramy al-jamarat prescribed in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the origin of ramy al-jamarat in hajj, linking it to the appearance of Iblis before Ibrahim عليه السلام and Ibrahim’s casting of stones at him. It also reports that Adam عليه السلام was the first to perform this act, followed by Ibrahim عليه السلام, showing its deep sacred antiquity in prophetic tradition.
